fields: [pic=8]Hey Mel, would you please get me the cookies?
*Charlotte hides under a blanket or something.*
[pic=3]M-Melody isn’t here right now, p-please come back later!
*Fade to black, remove Charlotte laying down, replace with Charlotte sitting by the kitchen*
[pic=2]Hey Rascal… I know we just met, but could I ask a favor?
[pic=6]I haven’t seen Charlotte this excited in a while.
[pic=2]Would you mind doing whatever she asks for a bit?
I was planning on it anyways!

Errr, sorry I didn’t mean to scare you.
I’m just a visitor.

Yeah, I came to the forest a few days ago.
I’m new here.
[pic=4]I see… Do you just walk into critter’s houses where you come from?
Well you don’t exactly have a door…
[pic=4]Wonderful! I’ll make it up to you somehow!

Honestly I’m surprised you haven’t heard of me.
I thought gossip traveled fast in the forest…
[pic=3]Ah, we’re kinda secluded up here… And I tend to keep to myself most of the times…
Um, I can leave if you want.
[pic=5]Oh, no that’s ok. You just really caught me off guard.
[pic=5]Nice to meet you. I see you aren’t from around here.
[pic=7]Red Panda, right? The first time I’ve seen one!

That’s right! I’ve come to experience
"the love!" of the forest!
[pic=6]O-Oh! Heh… Well that’s much more Melody’s department…
[pic=2]And you can take all the time you need until you’re ready, darling.
[pic=4]But really though, any day now would be great…
[pic=2]I see you’ve met a new friend?
[pic=4]I had to make sure you weren’t trying to hurt my poor little Charlotte.
[pic=6]As I’m sure you guessed, I’m Melody!
[pic=6]We weren’t expecting guests, or I would have had tea prepared…
[pic=2]Now, what can we do for you?
Do you happen to have Finley’s Stuff?
[pic=5]Oh yes, we put his stuff in a box.
[pic=6]We thought he’d come by to pick it up but…
[pic=6]I guess we pushed him too far…
[pic=7]Yeaaaah we definitely took him for granted.
[pic=7]See Rascal, we were a bit of a handful as roommates…
[pic=7]But we definitely could’ve tried a little harder…
[pic=5]… You know, that gives me an idea!
